title: EDCH open interactive resources: H5P courses on Diamond Open Access publishing
description: Interactive H5P learning resources on Diamond Open Access publishing (DOAS), with the static site that plays them. Each .h5p package in sources/ is the editable source and can be imported into Moodle or any platform that supports H5P.
notes: Check before the first release: one package (doas-copyright-and-licences) declares no licence. Declare it, or remove the package, so that this record's licence is accurate for every file.
